data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the Syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 203.717m. During 2017 the Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening (adverse development) of GBP 77.132m (37.9% of opening reserves). The movement is reflected in the technical provisions reconciliation and is driven primarily by adverse development in property/fire and marine classes (net of reinsurance the adverse movement is GBP 71.4m). The report attributes a material portion of the 2017 deterioration to the impact of hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria together with increased attritional claims.
raw_causal_phrases: was adversely impacted by the impact of hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria together with some increases in attritional claims.
The impact of the hurricanes and the higher than expected attritional claims has resulted in a claims ratio of 98.4% compared to 56.6% in 2016.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves (gross claims outstanding) taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) 2016 comparative column. Prior year development (gross) taken from Note 16 'Change in prior year provisions' (Gross = GBP 77,132k). The narrative in Note 6 and the managing agent text report a net adverse movement of GBP 71.4m (net of reinsurance) - class-level breakdown in Note 6 appears net-of-reinsurance; lob_movements use the class figures shown in Note 6 (these are net figures printed in parentheses as adverse amounts) and have been converted to signed strengthening amounts. Gross triangle (Note 15) was used to capture development rows. Where net vs gross distinctions apply this is documented here.
